# @llmnative/agentico

> Agentic chat orchestrator for @llmnative/react apps. A persistent panel: the orchestrator
> collects parameters in conversation and hands the work to host-registered subagents. Every
> subagent has a deterministic fallback. Agentico knows nothing concrete about the host.

## Host responsibilities (startup)

- `registerSubagents(manifests)` — SubagentManifest: id, label, icon, description, indexPath, commands (name, summary, Zod inputSchema, describeOutput), definition (AgentDefinition), toParams, destinationIds, optional crossAgentToolIds, withCollected, manualEntry, componentContexts.
- `registerDestinations({ id: ResultDestination })` — apply(result, { scopeId, dataProvider, storageProvider, proxyFetch }, meta).
- `registerSubagentReports({ subagentId: SubagentReportModule })`.
- `registerCrossAgentTools((ctx) => AgentTool[])` — ctx: attachmentsRef, collected (per-conversation scratchpad), proxyFetch.
- `configureAgenticoPrompts(partial)` — model-facing pack; `agenticoPromptsEn` (default) / `agenticoPromptsIt`.
- `configureEntityChatStore({ storageKey })`.
- i18n: merge `agenticoTranslations.<locale>` into `<App i18n={{ translations }}>`; override any `agentico.*` key.

## Mount

```tsx
<AgenticoProvider scope={{ id, dataProvider, storageProvider } | null}>
  <AgenticoToggle />
  <Agentico />
</AgenticoProvider>
```

## Hooks

- `useAgentico()` — panel state, `startOrchestrator(goal, opts)`, `commitEntityChat(subagentId, entityId, taskId, scopeId, params, title)`, `scope`.
- `useAgenticoPageContext(text, card?)` — what the user is looking at.
- `useSubagentComponentContext(subagentId, componentKey)` — anchor a component to a subagent.
- `useAgent(definition)` — run an AgentDefinition directly.

## AgentDefinition

buildContext (always runs) · buildPrompt · buildFollowUpPrompt · parseResponse (null → fallback) · fallback (required) · describeFallback? · getTools? · microPromptIds?
